{{Top|leg}}
A '''Force hunter''' was a type of [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]].

A Force hunter was a specialized bounty hunter that hunted [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] individuals. Considered to be one of the most dangerous specializations a bounty hunter can ply, Force hunters were renowned for the training they underwent to ply their trade; mental training rendered them considerably harder to find in [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], with a conditioned mind that allowed for a higher resistance to [[Mind trick/Legends#Force illusion|mind-affecting]] [[Force power/Legends|Force powers]] and [[Mind trick/Legends|tricks]]. Additionally, Force hunters trained in precision fire - techniques that allowed for carefully timed shots that compensated for a Force-users ability to block and reflect shots.
